title: Tier Placement, Supplemental Effective Dates and Recertification Records — Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage
content:
**Rule.** The tier of a coverage follows the Medigap plan letter and QMB status on file, never what the caller believes the policy pays: verified QMB status places the coverage in the QMB tier whatever Medigap is on file; otherwise plan letter A or B, K, L, or C, D, F, G, M or N places it in the matching tier, and no Medigap policy places it in the tier without supplemental coverage. A newly reported Medigap policy is recorded with the carrier's policy effective date as the supplemental effective date, and a new QMB determination with the first day of the month after the determination month. A signed physician recertification is recorded as the last certification date.

### Placement table for Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage

| QMB status on file | Medigap plan letter on file | Tier |
|---|---|---|
| Verified | Any, or none | Medicare Part A with QMB Medicaid Crossover |
| Not verified | A or B | Medicare Part A with Medigap Plan A or B |
| Not verified | K | Medicare Part A with Medigap Plan K |
| Not verified | L | Medicare Part A with Medigap Plan L |
| Not verified | C, D, F, G, M or N | Medicare Part A with Full-Coinsurance Medigap |
| Not verified | None | Medicare Part A Without Supplemental Coverage |

### Dates recorded

| Event | Date recorded |
|---|---|
| Newly reported Medigap policy | Supplemental effective date = the carrier's policy effective date |
| New QMB determination | Supplemental effective date = the first day of the month after the determination month |
| Signed physician recertification | Last certification date |

*Hypothetical illustration:* a caller says a policy "pays everything", but the plan letter on file is B and QMB is not verified; the coverage sits in the Medigap Plan A or B tier.
